subject.title: [Bug]: Native Talk button triggers OpenAI Realtime WebRTC call and fails with 500 when Realtime is not configured

question: Should Control UI browser Talk be enabled by implicit OpenAI realtime credential availability, or only by explicit `talk.realtime` readiness/preflight before microphone/WebRTC startup?
rationale: Current code and docs allow browser Talk through realtime provider/auth resolution, while this report expects local/non-Realtime Talk setup not to start OpenAI Realtime; either direction changes user-facing setup semantics.

options.title: Gate on Gateway availability preflight
options.body: Use a Gateway-owned realtime readiness result to disable or block Talk before microphone startup while preserving whichever credential policy maintainers choose.

options.title: Keep implicit credential activation
options.body: Accept that configured OpenAI realtime credentials enable browser Talk and focus the remaining work on clearer provider/API error messages.

options.title: Require explicit realtime config
options.body: Only show/start browser Talk when `talk.realtime` is explicitly configured, accepting or migrating the upgrade impact for existing users.

recommendation.title: Gate on Gateway availability preflight
recommendation.body: Use a Gateway-owned realtime readiness result to disable or block Talk before microphone startup while preserving whichever credential policy maintainers choose.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work touched OpenAI realtime credential behavior and public docs, making this the closest current owner trail for the enablement policy choice.
